spec.name: Orange Kitchen Sushi Counter
spec.description: Warm oak sushi cabinet with paneled storage, a bamboo preparation mat, salmon nigiri, a recessed soy dish and a slim chef knife. Cabinet footprint is 16×16, with feet grounded at y0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Sushi Counter. Warm wood sushi preparation cabinet, a rolled bamboo mat across the top, inset small soy dish and a delicate chef knife along the edge. Main cabinet collision footprint x0..16,y0..16,z0..16, front -Z. Cooktop props may extend to y25.
